turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Nice to meet you too, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what finally got me here is that I'm having a lot of trouble at work. I'm an electrician, and lately... I just can’t keep my focus on one estimate or code form anymore. 

It's like every little thing pulls me off track. I'll be trying to concentrate, and then I'll hear a tool noise, or I'll get a text, or I'll just suddenly have some new idea about the workshop, and I completely lose what I was doing. It's pretty frustrating because jobs are starting to get all mixed up, so I figured I needed to come in and figure out what's going on.
